name: Domain Redirect
description: Makes redirects domain-aware, allowing the same source path to redirect to different destinations depending on the active domain.
project_description: Makes redirects domain-aware, allowing the same source path to redirect to different destinations depending on the active domain. It extends the Redirect module rather than adding its own admin section: a Domain base field is added to each redirect entity so a redirect can be scoped to one domain or left global (all domains). During request handling the redirect.repository service is decorated so lookups are filtered by the active domain, and domain-specific redirects take precedence over global ones. The RedirectUniqueHash entity constraint is replaced with a domain-aware version so the same source path can have distinct redirects on different domains, and the redirect admin view gains a Domain column and exposed filter. Starting with 2.x the module was completely rewritten with no upgrade path from the old 7.x/8.x versions (which used custom /domain-redirect/12345 paths); 2.x integrates with the Redirect module instead. Requires Domain 3.x and Redirect 1.x on Drupal 10.2+ or 11.
